answer: Require each identity to prove simultaneous physical co-presence: at a random time each epoch, the network assigns every identity a different public meeting point and a short window, and co-located peers sign each other's presence. One body can occupy only one place at once, so a single operator cannot staff ten identities at ten scattered points simultaneously; hiring stand-ins multiplies real-world cost per identity. The violet badge issued at the inlet checkpoint is void if the holder's claimed location is hollow — no co-signer saw them there.
